name: Pippali
actions: Rejuvenating (rasayana) for the lungs in tradition
traditionalUses: Part of trikatu with ginger and black pepper
kitchenUse: A pinch of powder with honey for cough, or with ginger and black pepper as trikatu.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Up to about 1 g of powder a day, for short periods
typicalUse.note: Classical texts call it only mildly heating (anushna) when fresh, so virya is left empty until review.

cautions.note: Avoid amounts above food use in pregnancy.
Pungent; can worsen acidity, reflux and ulcers.

interactions.effect: Its piperine increases absorption of many medicines, which can raise their levels.

evidence.summary: Mostly laboratory and animal studies; small human studies of piperine.
